item.title: “The Prime Minister has my full support” insists Wes Streeting browsing carpet samples for Downing Street
item.description: Health Secretary Wes Streeting has come out in full support of Prime Minister Keir Starmer, despite being spotted asking B&Q staff which carpet would look best in 10 Downing Street.

item.title: Team GB protests at continued exclusion of ‘Hill Slide on Carrier Bag’ from Winter Olympics
item.description: The British team have today submitted a formal complaint to the organisers of the China Winter Olympic event over the continued exclusion of traditional British winter sport, the hill slide on a carrier bag.

item.title: MP who’s never in the office demands you work in an office
item.description: Nigel Farage has said something, again.

item.title: Mrs Starmer gets started on packing anyway
item.description: Keir Starmer's wife reckons it would still be a good idea to start packing away a few of the more fragile nick-nacks.

item.title: Nigel Farage insists his girlfriend owns the home he won’t be working from
item.description: Nigel Farage has once again been forced to clarify it was actually his partner who paid for the Clacton home he won’t be working from.

item.title: “Important to focus on the victims” says journalist preparing to write 2000 words focused on the men
item.description: A journalist writing their 2000-word commentary piece on the men involved in the Epstein scandal has prefaced it with the phrase “it’s important to focus on the victims” in an attempt to make it seem like he believes that it’s important to focus on the victims.

item.title: Spurs seek new manager, ideally with EFL Championship experience
item.description: Tottenham Hotspur have sacked Thomas Frank and are looking for a new manager to see them through next season's inevitable Championship campaign.

item.title: Spurs fan vows to not cut his hair until the team w̶i̶n̶s̶ ̶f̶i̶v̶e̶ ̶g̶a̶m̶e̶s̶ ̶i̶n̶ ̶a̶ ̶r̶o̶w̶ strings five passes together
item.description: A crazy Spurs fan has vowed to not cut his hair until the team win five games in a row… wait, no… until the team strings five passes together in a single game.

item.title: ‘Immigrants cost UK too much money’ says migrant who moved to tax-free Monaco
item.description: Sir Jim Ratcliffe has accused immigrants of costing the UK too much money, despite saving himself billions in tax by moving to Monaco.

item.title: Demographic committing less than 1% of mass shootings is the real danger to society, insists demographic committing more than 99% of mass shootings
item.description: Right-wing culture warriors have today warned that society is under imminent threat from a demographic responsible for less than 1% of mass shootings, while urging calm, nuance and “not all men” energy when discussing the demographic responsible for more than 99% of them.
